q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: SELECT A.NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS A WHERE A.SALES_ID NOT IN (SELECT B.SALES_ID FROM SALESPERSON AS B INNER JOIN ORDERS AS C ON B.SALES_ID = C.SALES_ID INNER JOIN COMPANY AS D ON D.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE D.NAME = 'RED')
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT A.NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS A WHERE A.SALES_ID NOT IN (SELECT B.SALES_ID FROM SALESPERSON AS B INNER JOIN ORDERS AS C ON B.SALES_ID = C.SALES_ID INNER JOIN COMPANY AS D ON D.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE D.NAME = 'RED')
explanation: Both queries are designed to find the names of salespersons who have not made any orders for the company named 'RED'.
